forward.adaptation: D256 causal head-dimension split with compact BF16 high/residual log-normalizer statistics.

helpers: Shared NAX helper provenance and notices are in gdn_PROVENANCE.json and docs/studio-compute/bf16-backward/third-party/.
backward: Repository implementation with Metal Performance Primitives; M=32, N=256, eight SIMD groups. Query ownership and shared-score key/value ownership; deterministic grouped-head reductions, no global atomics.
storage: BF16 Q/K/V/output and row-statistic pairs; score and derivative tiles remain device-local. Register accumulators use float.
qualification: Independent FP64 forward and derivatives, maximum-context tails, fixed-rate real-27B memorization, exact restore, and dtype audit pass. Cached backward speed at 57K keys remains below the twofold objective.
